description: Implementation of MojoCdmFileIO class handling file operations (open, read, write, close) via Mojo IPC for media CDM files in Chromium project.

classes.name: MojoCdmFileIO
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file I/O operations for media CDM files via Mojo IPC, managing states and error reporting.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initiates opening a file with the specified name via Mojo storage.

methods.name: OnFileOpened
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of the open request, updates state and notifies client.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Starts reading data from the open file.

methods.name: OnFileRead
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of the read operation, passes data to client.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the open file, with size limit enforcement.

methods.name: OnFileWritten
methods.description: Callback invoked after write operation, notifies client of success or failure.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file and releases resources.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error conditions, schedules client notification.

methods.name: NotifyClientOfError
methods.description: Notifies client of specific error conditions.
